name: Javanese Court Gamelan from the Pura Paku Alaman, Jogyakarta
editorial_article: Recorded by ethnomusicologist Robert E. Brown on January 10, 1971, in the reception hall of the Pura Paku Alaman, this album captured the heirloom gamelan ensemble directed by K.R.T. Wasitodiningrat. The recording was produced by Teresa Sterne for the Nonesuch Explorer Series and features the sléndro-tuned Kyai Pengawé Sari on tracks one and three, and the pélog-tuned Kyai Telaga Muntjar on tracks two and four. Ambient environmental sounds, including nesting sparrows in the hall, are audible throughout the performance, which was originally intended as a birthday honor for Paku Alam VIII. The track "Puspawarna" gained international recognition when it was selected for inclusion on the Voyager Golden Record. The album earned a nomination for the Grammy Award for Best Ethnic or Traditional Folk Recording in 1972.
editorial_pitch: A seminal 1971 field recording of Indonesian court music that features an heirloom ensemble and a track immortalized on the Voyager Golden Record.
vocals: Vocals provided by pesindhen Nyi Djiworetno, Niken Larasati, and Nyi Tasri.
